description: Use this when you need to forward a stored message to someone else, including a forwarded header block and the original attachments, on a new thread. Requires auth. Sends real email. Inputs: inbox_id (required; inbox id, username, or email), message_id (required), to (required; recipient addresses), cc, bcc, subject (optional; default is Fwd: plus the original subject unless it already starts with fwd: or fw:), text, html, include_attachments (optional; default true), client_id (optional idempotency key; a retry returns the original message and does not send again). Returns the stored message with a new thread_id. Fails with 400 missing_to, 400 attachments_too_large when copied attachments exceed 10 files, 4 MiB each, or 5 MiB total, 403 recipient_blocked, 403 recipient_suppressed, 403 inbox_paused, 404 message_not_found, 404 inbox_not_found, or 402 when the monthly send limit is reached.

client_id.description: Optional idempotency key. Reuse it to get the original forward instead of sending twice.

html.description: Optional HTML note placed before the forwarded block

inbox_id.description: Inbox id (inb_…), username, or full email address

include_attachments.description: Copy the original attachments. Default true. Over the size caps returns attachments_too_large.

subject.description: Subject line. Omit to use Fwd: plus the original subject, unless it already starts with fwd: or fw:.

text.description: Optional note placed before the forwarded block

name: cooper_forward_message
title: Forward a message
